audit.why: Melee duelist who beats you the moment Riposte (W) is up. Vitals (Duelist's Dance, P) heal her off every trade, so the lane is a cooldown-reading matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Grand Challenge (R) is 110/90/70, reveals all four Vitals and heals her; World Ender is 120/100/80. Riposte (W) is 24/22/20/18/16 — the cooldown that actually decides the level-6 fight.
audit.corrected: Grand Challenge (R) heals her off your Vitals on 110s. Commit only once Riposte (W, 24s at rank 1) is spent — then World Ender's amp out-drains the four-Vital window.

audit.why: Riposte parries all damage and stuns if it catches a champion, so it eats a Q sweetspot or a Q3 knock-up. Lunge (Q, 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6) applies on-hit effects, so her damage scales with attack speed and raw armour reads the trade wrong.

edits.before: Ultimate interaction changes all-ins. At level 6, reassess the matchup. Aatrox gains his ultimate, but Fiora's ultimate or scaling pattern may change whether you can commit.
edits.after: Grand Challenge (R) heals her off your Vitals on 110s. Commit only once Riposte (W, 24s at rank 1) is spent — then World Ender's amp out-drains the four-Vital window.
